description:
Join Ricky Carter, Shelley Quinn, Pastor James Rafferty, and Pastor Daniel Morikone for a compelling Bible Q&A as they tackle real questions from viewers around the world. Explore deep topics such as the nature of the Trinity, identifying a true prophet, understanding the "three days and three nights" of Christ's resurrection, and what it really means to put God first. The panel also addresses tithing and firstfruits, the power of prayer and Jesus' blood, Revelation's mysteries, and how free will relates to God's sovereignty. Discover Bible-based answers to grow your faith and deepen your walk with Christ.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.  Why does the Seventh-day Adventist church teach that God is a triune God when Jesus in John 17:1-3 states that his Father is the "only true God"? Can you please explain the trinity?

2. How can one know if someone is a prophet? A close friend of mine, a devoted follower of Christ, has been experiencing small glimpses of the future in her dreams, and they have come to pass. She is unsure of what is happening and where they are from, and has been seeking God’s guidance as they have been occurring for some years now. Could you kindly share insight into the signs of a prophet and whether this could be a valid experience?  

3.  Before his death on the stake, the religious leaders asked Yahshua for a sign. He replied that the only sign would be the sign of Jonah, who was three days and three nights in the belly of the fish, so would the son of man be in the grave. Show me three days and three nights from Friday night to Sunday morning? Please explain the three days and three nights of the resurrection?

4. What does it mean to put God first? When I wake up, I usually say a short prayer, eat breakfast, and then do my morning devotion. Does this mean I am not putting God first? Or is it about something deeper than the order of actions in the morning? 

5.  I receive Social Security & a small pension. I tithe 10% & give offerings. Are there other tithes we are supposed to give besides 10%? I am confused about first fruits. 

6. How do we explain Revelation 20:10 to people? Especially the part that says "Forever and ever"? 

7. Is there power in prayer or the blood of Jesus? 

8. What does Matthew 15:11 mean? 

9.  What is God’s Will? 

10. Is human free will limited or unlimited? Based on examples in the Bible like David’s choices and Pharaoh’s heart being hardened, what does this mean for our understanding of God’s sovereignty and love for Him? 

11. Can you explain Deuteronomy 12:12-25? 

12. Can you please explain Revelation 11:8? While this section of scripture is dealing with the French 3.5 year period of idolatry (Egypt) and immorality (Sodom) between 1793 and 1798, I am struggling with the last line of Verse 8, "where our Lord was crucified". Please help me understand this.
